title: Fix login blocked by inspection auth middleware
summary: Inspection router was mounted at API root with router-level authMiddleware, so every unauthenticated request including /auth/login returned 401. Mounted under /inspection and scoped auth to inspection routes only.
testFocus: Login/register must work without a token; equipment APIs under /inspection still require auth.
fastChecks: curl -s -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://machinefit.onrender.com/api/v1/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"email\":\"x@y.com\",\"password\":\"bad\"}"  (expect 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, not Authentication required)
productionChecks: GitHub Pages login form succeeds with valid credentials
Owner equipment pages still load after backend+frontend deploy

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main
deploy.note: Login fix requires Render backend redeploy; frontend path change is for /inspection prefix

asIs: POST /auth/login returns UNAUTHORIZED Authentication required — login impossible.
toBe: POST /auth/login reaches auth handler (invalid creds → INVALID_CREDENTIALS); valid login works.
